name: The Outer Bounds
description: Thornveil's outermost district, where the city gradually dissolves back into Feywood wilderness. Residences here are more dispersed than anywhere else in the city. Newer residents — integrated non-elves, elves returning from long absences, younger elves establishing their own lives — often settle in the Outer Bounds first, sometimes moving inward as their roots in the city deepen. The district also holds Thornveil's trade-staging area, the zone where goods bound for the Border's exchange windows are aggregated, where elven traders prepare for outbound journeys, and where returning traders unload realm-goods acquisitions before distribution. This is the most realm-facing part of Thornveil and the most likely to host occasional realm visitors on sanctioned business who are not ready or not permitted for deeper access.
